visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide, eye-level handheld shot of a narrow street in Taiwan. Sunlight illuminates the tall, light-colored apartment buildings on either side. Pedestrians walk towards a market stall with a pink and white striped awning. A yellow line is painted on the asphalt. (2) A medium shot captures a dense crowd gathered around a fruit stall. People of various ages, many wearing face masks and casual clothing, are packed together. A man in a green shirt is visible behind the counter, handling pineapples. (3) A woman with dark hair, glasses, and a red shirt layered under a blue apron stands at the counter. She uses both hands to lift two large, ripe pineapples and place them carefully onto a blue digital weighing scale. (4) The camera shifts to a close-up of a single, vibrant pineapple sitting on a crate. Its skin is a deep golden-orange, and its crown of green leaves is sharp and healthy. The background is filled with more fruit. (5) Hands in red gloves are shown in a close-up, using a specialized curved knife to peel the pineapple. The golden fruit is revealed as the thick, patterned skin is sliced away in smooth, efficient strokes. (6) A medium close-up shows a person's hand holding up a clear plastic identification tag. Inside the tag is a white card with the large red number '35' and Chinese text printed at the bottom. (7) The camera captures the man in the green shirt from a high angle as he continues to cut the peeled pineapple. He deftly slices the golden fruit into vertical columns and then horizontal chunks over a metal bowl. (8) A hand holds up a clear plastic bag filled with freshly cut, bright yellow pineapple cubes. The background shows the slightly blurred, sunlit market street with more pedestrians. (9) An extreme close-up focuses on three cubes of pineapple skewered on a thin wooden stick. The fruit appears moist and translucent, with fine fibers visible on the surface. (10) The woman in the red shirt is seen again, arranging more pineapples on the scale. The surrounding environment is cluttered with plastic crates, bags, and fruit. (11) The final shot shows the man in the green shirt from a medium-up perspective. He wears a blue surgical mask and focuses intently on his work, with a crowd of customers partially visible behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a male narrator speaking in a bright, energetic tone. An upbeat, electronic pop background track with a prominent synth bass and steady electronic drum beat begins immediately. The vocal delivery is fast and clear. (2) A subtle metallic slicing sound triggers a new phase as the narrator discusses the preparation of the fruit. The BGM continues without interruption, maintaining a high-energy vibe. Faint background noise of a market crowd is present. (3) The narrator's pitch fluctuates with excitement while describing the sweetness of the pineapple. A soft 'whoosh' sound effect transition is heard, coinciding with a visual cut. The music remains the primary secondary layer. (4) The narrator concludes with a friendly sign-off. The speech stops while the music continues for a fraction of a second before fading out with a clean hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Hook -> Crowded Scene -> Product Preparation -> Seller History -> Product Features -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Xie Qing Nan Pineapple' located in the Neiwei Market of Kaohsiung. It uses fast-paced editing and enthusiastic narration to highlight the popularity of the stall, the freshness of the fruit being cut on-site, and the long-standing 50-year reputation of the business to entice viewers to visit.
